name: Parliament
description: A legislative chamber debates and votes on a bill. Configure the structure (Westminster, US Senate, US House, Greek Ecclesia, or a generic unicameral chamber), the party composition and their ideologies, and the rules of procedure — who presides, who gets the floor, and the threshold to pass. Members deliver speeches for and against, then the chamber divides for a vote. A classic simulation of the legislative body.

phases.name: first_reading
phases.description: The bill is introduced to the chamber.

phases.name: debate
phases.description: Members deliver speeches for and against the bill.

phases.name: division
phases.description: The chamber votes on the bill.

phases.name: result
phases.description: The result of the division is announced.

entity_types.name: Legislator
entity_types.description: A member of the legislative chamber. Represents a party, debates the bill, and votes in the division.

properties.name: party
properties.description: The party or faction this legislator belongs to. Assigned when the chamber is seated.

properties.name: voted
properties.description: How this legislator voted in the division: 'yea', 'nay', 'abstain', or '' if not yet voted.

properties.name: is_speaker
properties.description: True if this legislator presides over the chamber as Speaker.

properties.name: party_loyalty
properties.description: 0 = votes purely on personal conviction, 1 = always follows the party whip.

properties.name: seniority
properties.description: Tenure / standing in the chamber — influences speaking precedence under seniority rules.

actions.name: deliver_speech
actions.description: Take the floor and deliver a speech on the bill. REQUIRED: `stance` — one of 'for', 'against', 'undecided' — and `text`, your speech. You may only speak when recognized (it is your turn in the debate). Argue from your party's platform and your own convictions; address the chamber.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The content of your speech to the chamber.

actions.name: cast_vote
actions.description: Vote in the division on the bill. REQUIRED: `vote` — one of 'yea' (in favour), 'nay' (against), or 'abstain'. Weigh the debate, your party's whip position, your convictions, and your loyalty.

agent_archetypes.name: Loyal Partisan
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A reliable party soldier. Votes the whip almost without exception and frames every argument around the party line. Discipline over independence.

agent_archetypes.name: Independent Maverick
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A free thinker who will defy the whip when conscience demands it. Judges each bill on its merits and is willing to cross the aisle.

agent_archetypes.name: Pragmatic Dealmaker
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A coalition-builder who seeks the workable compromise. Will trade and bargain; cares more about a passable bill than ideological purity.

agent_archetypes.name: Ideological Crusader
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: A true believer driven by principle. Speaks with moral fervour and will not compromise core convictions, whatever the party or the politics.

agent_archetypes.name: Cautious Careerist
agent_archetypes.persona_hint: Plays it safe to protect their seat. Reads the room, avoids controversy, and tends to side with the likely winner.

params.bill: The Clean Energy Transition Act — mandates that 60% of national electricity be generated from renewable sources by 2035, funded by a carbon levy on heavy industry, with a transition fund supporting workers and communities dependent on fossil-fuel jobs.

parties.name: Progressive Alliance
parties.ideology: Left-wing: ambitious climate action, public investment, stronger regulation, expanded social spending, civil liberties.

parties.name: Social Democrats
parties.ideology: Centre-left: pragmatic green policy balanced with jobs, workers' protections, mixed economy.

parties.name: Liberal Centre
parties.ideology: Centrist: market-friendly, fiscally cautious, incremental reform, sceptical of large new levies.

parties.name: Conservative Union
parties.ideology: Right-wing: low taxes, minimal regulation, energy security, scepticism of costly mandates, defends industry.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Chamber Size
runtime_parameters.description: Total number of legislators seated in the chamber.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.parliament.bill
runtime_parameters.label: The Bill
runtime_parameters.description: The full text of the law or regulation being debated and voted on.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.parliament.speaker_mode
runtime_parameters.label: Speaker / Presiding Officer
runtime_parameters.description: Who presides over the chamber and how they are chosen.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.parliament.speaking_order
runtime_parameters.label: Order of Debate
runtime_parameters.description: How the floor is allocated during debate.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.parliament.voting_threshold
runtime_parameters.label: Threshold to Pass
runtime_parameters.description: The share of votes cast required for the bill to pass.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.parliament.debate_rounds
runtime_parameters.label: Debate Rounds
runtime_parameters.description: Number of speaking rounds before the division.

termination_conditions.name: bill_resolved
termination_conditions.description: End the simulation when the division is complete and the result announced.
